name: PseudoEval
description: PseudoEval is a multilingual code generation benchmark designed to isolate and evaluate the language-coding capability of large language models by providing pseudocode solutions as input, thereby separating problem-solving from language-specific coding skills.
reputation: A recent, niche benchmark from the code-generation literature with limited community adoption so far, mainly used in the associated paper and follow-up evaluations.
notes: Enables analysis of bottlenecks in code generation by separating problem-solving from language-coding; supports multiple programming languages.
